content:
Welcome back to this week's Apple Certified Refurbished Store new stock update. This week's highlights include MacBook Neo, new MacBook Air configurations, Apple Watch Ultra 3, and more.

Apple's Certified Refurbished Store is a great way to save money, letting you purchase Apple products directly from Apple's official website at up to 15% off.

Here's what you need to know:

  • Outstanding quality, attractive prices
  • Go through a rigorous refurbishment process before being sold
  • Comes with a one-year Apple limited warranty
  • Eligible under Apple's 14-day return policy
  • AppleCare products can be purchased additionally
  • Engraving and gift wrapping services are not provided for refurbished products

We'll track every new arrival and price drop at the Apple Certified Refurbished Store so you don't have to. Stock changes quickly, and hopefully this report can help you snag your desired product before it sells out.

Mac computers

The MacBook Neo and MacBook Air remain my top picks for value. Both are excellent choices for users entering the Apple ecosystem for the first time or upgrading to Apple Silicon.

MacBook Neo

  • MacBook Neo with 256GB storage: $599 (original price $699)
  • MacBook Neo with 512GB storage and Touch ID: $679 (original price $799)

MacBook Air

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 512GB storage and 16GB memory: $1,099 (original price $1,299)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with 1TB storage and 16GB memory: $1,529 (original price $1,799)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with 2TB storage and 16GB memory: $1,949 (original price $2,299)

iMac

  • 24-inch M4 iMac with 256GB storage and 16GB memory: $1,269 (original price $1,499)
  • 24-inch M4 iMac with 512GB storage and 16GB memory: $1,439 (original price $1,699)

Studio Display

A few weeks ago we were the first to report that Studio Display XDR was in stock at the Apple Refurbished Store. As we've been reminding everyone, stock changes quickly, and Studio Display XDR is no exception. As of today, only two configurations remain in stock:

  • Studio Display XDR with standard glass and an adjustable tilt and height stand: $2,799 (original price $3,299)
  • Studio Display XDR with nano-texture glass and an adjustable tilt and height stand: $3,059 (original price $3,599)

Apple TV 4K

The base model Apple TV 4K, which has been out of stock for a long time, is back this week, along with the higher-end Ethernet version that's been consistently available. If you want one, act fast — the base model usually sells out quickly.

  • Apple TV 4K (3rd generation) with 64GB storage, Wi-Fi: $169 (original price $199)
  • Apple TV 4K (3rd generation) with 128GB storage, Wi-Fi plus Ethernet: $209 (original price $249)

Apple Watch Ultra

I wear my Apple Watch Ultra 3 every day. If you want to join this club, the Apple Refurbished Store has some great deals this week:

  • Apple Watch Ultra 3 (GPS + Cellular), 49mm black titanium case with black Ocean band: $679 (original price $799)
  • Apple Watch Ultra 3 (GPS + Cellular), 49mm natural titanium case with anchor blue Ocean band: $679 (original price $799)

As always, you can browse 9to5Tocks to stay on top of the latest Apple deals throughout the week.
